Benchmark Models
To fully utilize the prior information from the co-occurency graph, we
introduce several GNN-based methods for multivariate time series prediction. These methods leverage
GNNs to extract the influences between different variables, effectively capturing the relationships
among various time series. The specific models are as follows:
• EvolveGCN [80]: EvolveGCN introduces a recurrent mechanism to update the network
parameters, as GCN parameters, for capturing the dynamism of the graphs. Two methods
are introduced: EvolveGCNH, which learns the weight matrix of the graph at each time
18
